title: Digital Fundraising Manager
description:
Hack Club, a global nonprofit organization, is seeking an exceptional, mission-driven Digital Fundraising Manager to join our team and make a real impact on the lives of high school students around the world.


As our Digital Fundraising Manager, you will have the opportunity to shape the future of education by growing a network of grassroots donors and corporations who share our vision. You'll be at the forefront of our fundraising efforts, connecting with a global community of passionate individuals and corporate leaders who are committed to supporting the next generation of creators, innovators, problem-solvers, and entrepreneurs. You'll be part of an organization that believes in the power of technology to unlock unlimited potential in young minds. 

As the Digital Fundraising Manager, you will have the guidance and support needed to develop and execute a comprehensive digital fundraising strategy, leveraging your exceptional writing and marketing skills to engage donors in our mission through targeted campaigns, communication, and virtual and in-person events.

At Hack Club, we believe in investing in our team members' growth and professional development. You'll have access to a collaborative work environment, where your ideas and expertise will be valued. And you'll work alongside talented individuals who are passionate about making a difference in the lives of young people and building a movement that empowers the next generation of innovators and leaders.

Responsibilities:

  1. Design and implement a data-driven digital fundraising strategy to attract and retain donors and corporate sponsors using campaigns, communications, and virtual and in-person events.

  2. Develop a comprehensive corporate sponsorship offering that engages leading companies in supporting Hack Club’s work and vision.

  3. Craft compelling fundraising materials, appeals, impact reports and newsletters, and donor communications.

  4. Build and maintain a robust donor database, ensuring accurate and up-to-date donor information.

  5. Track digital fundraising revenue, manage gift processing, and ensure timely acknowledgment of donations.

  6. Monitor and evaluate digital fundraising trends and adjust strategies as needed to meet fundraising goals.

  7. Collaborate with the team on tracking programmatic outcomes, new projects, and organizational impact to inform content.

  8. Stay informed about best practices related to digital fundraising and philanthropy.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree, preferably in a relevant field (e.g., nonprofit management, fundraising, communications).

  • Experience at a direct service organization, preferably an organization that is focused on youth development or technology-based training

  • At least three years in nonprofit fundraising including substantial experience in developing targeted campaigns and creating donor and funder outreach materials.

  • Strong relationship-building skills and ability to connect with individuals from diverse backgrounds.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messages to different audiences.

  • Demonstrated ability to create and implement effective fundraising campaigns and events.

  • Depth of experience working with online fundraising or marketing platforms that help nonprofits efficiently meet their campaign goals.

  • Proficiency in using donor management software and CRM systems that provide data to inform strategic decision-making as it relates to donor engagement.

  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

  • A passion for education, technology, and empowering young people.

Location: The Digital Fundraising Manager must be able to work in Shelburne, Vermont, and will be expected to be on-site 5 days a week. 


Salary range: $45,000 - $55,000

Benefits: 

  • Health, dental, and vision packages

  • 4 weeks of PTO (including 1 week during the week of Christmas)

  • 11 additional paid holidays

  • $2,000 hardware stipend (enough for a MacBook Air, big monitor, etc)

Hack Club is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Deadline: Applications will be accepted until the position is filled.
